name: indie-payment-kit
description: One orchestrator that integrates official payment Skills into real projects and reports sandbox evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Integrate and sandbox-test payments from one entry point
interface.longDescription: Scan an indie SaaS, API, static site, or digital-product project; choose a global or China payment route; load current official provider packs internally; implement checkout, webhook, entitlement, refund, and subscription flows; and report sandbox evidence without sending the developer to a second Skill.
defaultPrompt: Use $indie-payment-kit to connect this project to the right payment provider and verify a sandbox payment.
Use $indie-payment-kit to add Stripe or Dodo Payments to this Next.js, TanStack, Hono, or HTML project.
Use $indie-payment-kit to review or migrate this payment integration without switching to another Skill.
